name: Imhotep
body:
Known as a polymath and the First Physician and Director of Sculptors, Imhotep is the only mortal to ascend to godhood among the deities of the desert. He treated the sick, advised kings, and supervised the building of elaborate structures.

Above all else, Imhotep was a seeker of knowledge. Imhotep’s focus is on scientific discoveries; his alignment is Neutral. Imhotep offers the artifice, healing, health, and knowledge domains, and his favored weapon is the iron brush.

Common Ailments

Imhotep appears as a human male with a shaved head, wearing a white robe and holding either a scroll or a staff. He is the patron deity of physicians, architects, scholars, and scientists.

Health

Granted Powers: Your knowledge of anatomy is exemplary, allowing you to heal injuries or precisely place your attacks to deal maximum damage to your enemies. With your knowledge of medicines, you can heal the sick and invigorate the weary. With GM permission, a cleric with access to the healing domain can select the health domain in its place.

Surgical Strike (Ex)

After you make a successful melee attack, you can use a swift action to declare the attack is a surgical strike.

The surgical strike automatically deals the maximum amount of damage possible. For example, a Medium cleric wielding a light mace would not roll damage for a surgical strike.

Instead, the damage would automatically be 6 + the cleric’s Strength modifier. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

Tonic (Su)

At 8th level, when you prepare your spells for the day, you can create an invigorating tonic. The tonic retains its potency for 24 hours, after which time, it reverts to plain water. When a living creature drinks the tonic as a move action, it removes the fatigued, exhausted, sickened, and nauseated conditions.

It also heals 1d8 hit points of damage for every four cleric levels you possess and grants a +2 circumstance bonus on Fortitude saving throws and Strength-based skill checks for 1 hour. You can create one tonic per day at 8th level, and one additional tonic per day for every four levels beyond 8th.

Domain: 1st-remove sickness, 2nd-lesser restoration, 3rd-protection from energy, 4thpersistent vigor, 5th-psychic surgery, 6th-wither limb, 7th-cure serious wounds, mass, 8th-inflict critical wounds, mass, 9th-implosion.
